title: Simple yet Effective Semi-supervised Knowledge Distillation from Vision-Language Models via Dual-Head Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2505.07675v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a practical solution for addressing data scarcity challenges by leveraging unlabeled data. Recently, vision-language models (VLMs), pre-trained on massive image-text pairs, have demonstrated remarkable zero-/few-shot performance that often surpasses SSL approaches due to their exceptional generalization capabilities. This gap motivates us to question: how can we effectively harness the powerful generalization capabilities of VLMs into task-specific models? Knowledge distillation (KD) offers a natural framework for transferring VLM capabilities, but we identify that it suffers from gradient conflicts between supervised and distillation losses. To address this challenge, we propose Dual-Head Optimization (DHO), which introduces dual prediction heads for each distinct signal. We observe that DHO mitigates gradient conflicts, enabling improved feature learning compared to single-head KD

translated_title: 基于双头优化的从视觉-语言模型进行简单而有效的半监督知识蒸馏
translated_abstract: 半监督学习（SSL）已成为通过利用无标签数据来解决数据稀缺挑战的实用解决方案。最近，在大规模图文对上预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）展现出卓越的零样本/少样本性能，由于其出色的泛化能力，往往超越了SSL方法。这一差距促使我们思考：如何才能有效地将VLM强大的泛化能力迁移到任务特定模型中？知识蒸馏（KD）为迁移VLM能力提供了一个自然的框架，但我们发现它在监督损失和蒸馏损失之间存在梯度冲突。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了双头优化（DHO），它为每种不同的信号引入了双预测头。我们观察到DHO缓解了梯度冲突，与单头KD相比，能够实现更好的特征学习。
tldr: 本文提出双头优化（DHO）方法，通过为监督信号和蒸馏信号分别设置独立的预测头来解决知识蒸馏中的梯度冲突问题，从而更有效地将视觉-语言模型的泛化能力迁移到半监督学习的任务特定模型中。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Dual-Head Optimization (DHO), which mitigates gradient conflicts between supervised and distillation losses by introducing separate prediction heads for each signal, enabling effective transfer of vision-language models' generalization capabilities to task-specific models in semi-supervised learning.
